text:
nina: Customer org-987 reports 400s from /v1/rerank when sending reshaped payload. Says it started after an SDK bump. Posting minimal repro they used.

nina: curl they ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"items": null, "topk": "3", "query": "best feature", "candidates": [{"id": 1, "text": "A", "score": "0.9"}] }'
```

sam: can you paste full response body & status code? also which SDK/version?

nina: 400, body returned: `{\"error\":\"Invalid request: 'items' must be an array of objects with keys (id,text)\"}`
Customer is on their own thin wrapper (Go net/http) not official SDK.

lee: quick notes: two things here look off -> `items` is `null` not an array, and `topk` is sent as a string (`"3"`) instead of a number. also candidate `score` is a string. Any JSON parser will accept that but our validation layer expects specific types.

lee: repro steps I ran locally (slice of what to try):
```js
// simulate bad request
const bad = { items: null, topk: "3", query: "best feature", candidates: [{ id: 1, text: "A", score: "0.9" }] }
// server-side check (pseudo)
if (!Array.isArray(bad.items)) throw new Error("items must be array")
if (typeof bad.topk !== 'number') throw new Error("topk must be number")
```

nina: customer insists they didn't change payload intentionally; might be our proxy or mobile lib tampering. They said content-type header is application/json.

sam: can you ask for raw bytes (capture) or a HAR? if proxy is rewriting, we need raw request. Also request id from our logs?

nina: I pulled server logs for their API key, few entries: `request_id=rz-8a7f status=400 error=\"items must be array\"`. I attached anonymized request dump from our edge: body was `{"items":null,"topk":"3",...}`.

lee: next steps: 1) ask customer for HAR or tcpdump; 2) try to reproduce with curl exactly (we already saw repro locally). I'll open ENG-ML issue to make error explain expected types and include offending field in message. Right now message is generic.

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-2025-879 and assigned to eng-ml (lee). Link: https://internal.redwood/tickets/SUP-2025-879

sam: thanks. also let's add a short snippet to support KB showing common client mistakes: items=null, topk as string, scores as strings. I'll draft. :thumbsup:

nina: forwarding to customer with request_id and quick checklist to validate client JSON types and to capture HAR if issue persists.
